visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a series of quick cuts showing a Netflix-themed event space. In a dimly lit venue, platters of pizza, french fries, and fried chicken are displayed on white counters. A large chalkboard prominently features the title '忘了我記得' (Forgot Me Remember) with a Netflix logo. A woman with dark hair wearing a beige vest walks through a red velvet curtained booth. (2) The scene transitions to a bright, indoor setting modeled after a convenience store. The main character, a woman with long dark hair in a white shirt and denim vest, explores shelves filled with snacks and beverages. She smiles broadly while pointing at a row of tea eggs in a cooker and then moves toward a refrigerator stocked with colorful bottled drinks and boxed milk. (3) At a checkout counter, the woman interacts with a female clerk wearing a dark blue uniform. The woman places several items, including a bottle of water and a snack pack, on the white counter. She uses expressive hand gestures and facial expressions, laughing as she talks to the camera and the clerk. Yellow and white text overlays appear on the screen. (4) The woman and a male companion in a black denim vest are seen at a row of yellow and white gashapon machines. They crouch down, turning the dials and retrieving plastic prize capsules. They both show high energy and excitement. The camera follows them as they walk down a staircase with red walls and steps marked with yellow safety tape. (5) In a different booth area, the woman holds a yellow sticky note and writes with a black marker. She later shows a small, rectangular device that resembles an orange and pink cassette tape. She holds it close to her face, speaking into the built-in microphone with exaggerated facial expressions, winking and smiling at the lens. (6) The video cuts to a larger event stage with a brick-wall background and a neon 'Talk Show' sign. Several people, identified as actors and a director, are introduced on stage to loud applause. A crowd of attendees is visible from the back, many holding up smartphones to record the presentation. The actors sit on high stools for an interview session. (7) The woman displays a small keychain that looks like a miniature package of 'Squid Shreds' (魷魚絲). The final scene shifts to a man in a grey t-shirt sitting in a black and red gaming chair. He holds the cassette recording device, listens to the playback, and breaks into a wide smile and laughter while looking toward the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-tempo, upbeat electronic pop music characterized by a bright synthesizer lead and a steady percussive beat. A female voice (the main character) speaks with high arousal and a bright, excited tone, introducing the Netflix event. Background crowd chatter is faint. (2) A sharp, metallic 'ding' sound effect occurs as the character interacts with a convenience store setup. The sound of plastic rustling and items being moved on a hard counter is audible. The female voice remains dominant, maintaining a playful and energetic pitch contour throughout the interaction. (3) A sequence of rapid mechanical clicks and a rotating dial sound signify the operation of a gashapon machine. This is followed by the sound of a plastic capsule hitting a tray. The BGM swells slightly in volume, maintaining its rhythmic drive as the character laughs loudly. (4) The audio texture shifts as the character records a message; the playback has a distinct lo-fi, filtered quality with reduced high-frequency clarity. She sings a short, melodic phrase. A cartoonish 'pop' SFX and a comedic meme-style 'whoosh' are synchronized with visual transitions. (5) A massive surge in crowd noise—including cheering, high-pitched whistling, and sustained applause—marks the introduction of celebrities on stage. The BGM volume ducks significantly to allow the amplified microphone voices of the stage presenters to be heard with noticeable room reverb. (6) The final phase features a male voice laughing with a warm, genuine tone. The previous lo-fi recording is played back again. A post-production 'laugh track' SFX is added for comedic effect as the upbeat BGM fades out with a smooth cross-fade.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional vlog for the Netflix series 'Forgot Me Remember'. It aims to generate excitement and engagement by showcasing a themed pop-up event where the main character participates in interactive activities (convenience store, gashapon, voice recording) and highlights the presence of the show's cast and director. The energetic tone and meme-style editing are designed to appeal to a young, social-media-savvy audience.
